newsitem.title: USA: AmerUS Life Holdings Q1 oper inc rises.
newsitem.headline: AmerUS Life Holdings Q1 oper inc rises.

text.p: NOTE: First quarter 1996 net income includes a $38 million after tax gain from the sale of investments.
Revenues, excluding realized gains, was $155.7 million in the first quarter 1997 versus $150.5 mililion for the same quarter in the same period last year.
Equity add-on tax is the mutual life insurance company equity add-on tax.
AmerUS Life was formed as part of the reorganization of American Mutual Life Insurance Co. It completed its initial public offering in February 1997.
AmerUS develops and markets annuity products and variable life insurance through Ameritas Variable Life Insurance Co, a joint venture formed in mid-1996 with Ameritas Life Insurance Corp in Nebraska.
